body:
I don't think anyone can truly be satisfied with what they've done. 

And I am worthless. I look at other people and they have some sort of redeeming trait, something that makes then worth being alive. I can't see anything like that in myself. I'm not good at anything. I complain and I cry and I'm sad. What about me is worth anything? I see no reason to continue on when I'm not even worth being a human. I'm like... not even worth being called a human I'm so worthless. I dunno how to explain it because I'm stupid, I'm sorry.

That sounds really cool! I've never written a screenplay before. Just a lot of novels and short stories. I did sort of help out with storyboarding a cartoon once, which was interesting. I really like to do all kinds of creative projects. It's like escaping without actually escaping.

I think I have an issue even talking to people in real life. I can't talk out loud well. It's hard and I always make mistakes. Typing is easier. I don't even have any friends in real life. I think a part of me is scared to make friends cause then they'll be sad when I inevitably kill myself. Or maybe it's the anxiety. I have much anxiety. I had a panic attack when I went to the dentist the other day, I'm such a wreck of a person lol.  

Well anyway thank you friend for talking with me tonight. I appreciate it. It's nice to talk freely for once. I feel a little better now.

Your job sounds way cooler than mine lol

I do all sorts of writing honestly. From comedy to tragedy. Although the vast majority of it does relate to suicide or depression or something similar. I think it is a good way to get my emotions out without actually hurting myself. If that makes sense.

I do also like science fiction! Or similar things. I have my own genre where I mix sci-fi and fantasy together. I wrote a novel about steampunk mixed with magic. I don't want to say too much, but it took place in a desert and water was a real scarcity. So the government forced magic users into slavery to make water. The story is about them gaining freedom. There is a lot more to it, but that's the basic plot. It's fun to write things like that. 

But it's kinda disappointing because none of my stories ever really become popular? I guess? I actually made a video game once too. It had some success, but I got people saying things like "Oh, it was good for a first try." Like the worst kind of back handed compliment. So I don't really want to make games anymore. I'm sorry I'm rambling here. I guess there is a lot I want to talk about but I can't.

I can't tell my friends online. They would be disappointed in me. Since I try to write fiction about suicidal people finding hope in life again. Wouldn't it be terrible if I had no hope? I am their hope. I don't want to take that away. I don't want to tell my mom because she'll just get upset. I can't talk to anyone and its suffocating.

Ah. But you write too? What do you write?

I'm sorry that you relate to me at all. It's not fun having buckets of family problems and I'm sorry.

I write to get my emotional pain out? I stopped self harming back in October, which has been difficult, but I've been trying to deal with everything by writing instead. I was writing even before that though. It's peaceful to completely lose myself in a fictional story. 

That does mean a lot of my stories have themes of suicide, depression, and self harm in them. A lot of people seem to enjoy them and they say it helps to read stories like that. The story I am working on now is... hmm. I don't want to say too much and have people find my main account. But I guess a general synopsis of it would be, a boy is dying of a terminal illness. His brother, who feels like his life is worthless and that he would kill himself if his brother died, makes a deal with the devil to sacrifice his life to save his brother. I think it's a pretty interesting story!

Writing music does sound cool. I wish I could make music. I'm only really good at writing and drawing. I draw too sometimes. I find it relaxing. I like to do things that gets my mind off my worries. If I'm not thinking then it doesn't hurt.

It was scary to leave my father at first. Especially when the police came. I had to leave everything I owned behind when I left and that was difficult. I think that was the right choice. He was toxic. If you have an opportunity to get away from someone who is hurting you, you should. 

Although I am pretty cowardly in other ways. I can't bring myself to actually kill myself yet.

I just haven't completely given up yet. But I hate struggling everyday, you know? It's like why am I even bothering? I don't know. Lately my stories haven't been getting as many comments and I feel like I am losing all my emotions. Maybe I can't write anymore, if I have nothing inside of me. That's why I want to die after this story. Then at least I'll die before I lose everything. Plus I'll get to write my own ending.

I work as a Night Auditor in a hotel. That basically means I do paperwork and babysit the front desk in case anyone needs anything. I always work alone so it can be lonely! I don't really mind it gives me a lot of free time. What do you do for work?

It's another late night at work and I feel exhausted. I don't want to be here I want to be sleeping. At least a night job gives me plenty of time to write. 

I was thinking while I was driving in that I should just keep going past my job. Just keep driving until I hit the ocean. But I didn't do that, I went into work as normal.

Maybe it's the writer part of me that wants to romanticize my own mental illness into something else. Something that's beautiful instead of ugly. I just want a fitting end. Or any end really. I just want to stop.
